thread:
Alex H.: uploaded a quick figma for a small 'pinboard' micro-interaction in the trace viewer — link: https://figma.com/s/trace-pinboard
Alex H.: TL;DR: allow people to hover a trace or span and pin it to a temporary pinboard (session-scoped). From the pinboard you can: reorder, annotate, export (JSON/CSV), or copy a shareable permalink. Want feedback on copy, placement, and a11y.
Sam G.: I like the idea. Clarify: pin at span-level or request-level? Span-level might be noisy.
Alex H.: primary is request-level (request drilldown), but you can optionally expand to select specific spans for export.
Maria P.: Copy suggestions: primary CTA should be "Add to pinboard" (verb first). Secondary action in the pinboard: "Copy permalink" and "Download selection". For the hover tooltip, short copy: "Pin this request".
Jay L.: engineering constraints: we can implement client-side (localStorage) quickly. Persisting server-side needs an API & auth. If we limit to local session it avoids extra infra. Also: cap to 25 pins and show a clear "Clear pins".
Sam G.: accessibility notes: pin icon must be keyboard focusable and reachable from the trace keyboard nav. Tooltip must be accessible via aria-describedby, and the copy action needs aria-live feedback: "Permalink copied to clipboard." Also make sure the pinboard is reachable with a skip-link: "Skip to pinboard" when open.
Alex H.: agree. For keyboard flow I'm thinking: when focus moves into a trace item, show a small action bar with [Pin] (button), [More ▾]. Pin should be a <button> with aria-pressed state. Tooltip text: "Pin request to session board".
Maria P.: UX nit on wording: avoid "session" in copy for end-users. Propose: "Pin to board" and in the header show small hint: "Pins are temporary for this browser session." That keeps CTAs short.
Sam G.: implementation detail: aria-pressed is good, but also ensure screen readers get a clear label like "Pin request for sharing". For copy action: prefer to expose a small inline menu with the single action "Copy link" instead of instantly copying on pin.
Alex H.: good call. For export formats — product: JSON and CSV first. Also add an "Export trace bundle" which includes stacktrace + context. We'll add a small checkbox list in the export modal.
Jay L.: perf concern: exporting full trace bundles can be large. We should stream bundles and show progress. Also cap export to N spans or size limit. Telemetry: track pin count, export type, and whether permalink was copied.
Maria P.: Accessibility copy: exported file name should be predictable: "redwood-trace-<request-id>.json" and include UTF-8 BOM for some Excel compatibility in CSV.
Alex H.: visual polish question: where to place the pinboard CTA in the console header? Option A: tack on a small pinboard icon near the search bar. Option B: use a floating dock to the right of the trace list. Thoughts?
Sam G.: Option A is discoverable but might clutter header. Option B is obvious while you're in traces but could overlap content on narrow screens. If floating, make it collapsible and dismissible with ESC.
Maria P.: prefer Option B for discovery during a deep-dive, but keep a tiny persistent indicator in the header showing count (like a badge) that opens the board. That gives both discoverability and global access.
Alex H.: a11y: floating dock must follow focus trap rules when opened and restore focus when closed. Also ensure it works with high-contrast themes.
design-bot: uploaded a screenshot preview (screenshot-1711112222.png)
Jay L.: dev implementation plan: I'll prototype a minimal client-side version — pin state in localStorage keyed by session id, telemetry events for add/remove/export/copy. I can ship a beta behind a feature flag.
Maria P.: +1 to feature flag. For copy text in the tooltip: final proposals — hover: "Pin this request"; button label: "Add to board"; in board header: "Board (temporary)" with an info icon that opens a short modal describing persistence.
Alex H.: I'll iterate copy in figma and adjust placement per this convo. Action items: Alex — update figma with header badge + floating dock variant. Sam — confirm keyboard nav prototype. Jay — prototype localStorage + telemetry. Maria — finalize copy for tooltips and export modal.
Sam G.: timeline estimate: prototype in 1 sprint if we scope to client-side only.
Maria P.: tagging @eng-product for prioritization in planning. :thumbsup:
Alex H.: thanks all — will post updated figma and a short demo GIF when ready.
